note: Shared bash hard-block test vectors. Single source of truth for TS (packages/duoduo/src/tool/bash.ts classifyCommand) and Rust (crates/agent-executor/src/bash_safety.rs blocked). 'ts' = verdict of classifyCommand alone, 'rust' = combined verdict of the legacy regex list + semantic overlay. Both columns MUST be identical (bash_safety.rs asserts it). IMPORTANT: these vectors only cover the CLASSIFIER (the capability boundary). The second gate — the spatial boundary (`out_of_bounds_paths` / the destructive-target check in BashTool.collect) — is not exercised here, which is why `rm -rf /` reads 'allow': deleting inside the project is legitimate, and deleting outside it is stopped by the spatial gate, not by the classifier. P0-4 nested-payload recursion (shell -c / find -exec / xargs) is covered by dedicated tests (bash_safety.rs nested tests; test/tool/bash-safety.test.ts nested walk), not by this file — the classifier itself is not recursive.
